title: Store shared worktree claims outside .git
description: Move ephemeral cross-worktree claim registry out of the common Git directory and into the machine-local Plantool data directory, preserving coordination between worktrees.
why: Agent environments may be permitted to read .git but not write there. Claiming tickets currently fails because Plantool creates .git/plantool/claims.lock and claims.json.

acceptance.text: No Plantool command creates or writes claim files under .git
Claims remain shared between worktrees in the same local environment
The claim storage location and override are documented

todos.text: Update worktree claim test to verify storage and coordination
Run full checks and validate no repository .git writes

outcome.summary: Moved shared worktree claim files from .git into the machine-local PLANTOOL_HOME store and documented the path.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check (121 passed, 1 skipped); claim test confirms cross-worktree coordination and absence of .git/plantool; plantool check (0 warnings); git diff --check.
